user_query: I'm a collector of Roman artifacts. Can you give me a random Roman God's description from the Roman Gods By Pizza API? Also, fetch the list of transactions submitted to the database using the Felina Multisig Wallet API to see if there are any interesting artifacts available.

TaskList.description: Fetch a random description of a Roman God from the Roman Gods By Pizza API.
Retrieve the list of transactions submitted to the database using the Felina Multisig Wallet API to check for available artifacts.
